company.name: Panorama Education
company.shortDescription: Panorama Education brings the power of data to education through a SaaS platform used by thousands of school districts across the US.
company.description: Panorama Education is the leading platform for student support and learning. The platform connects MTSS, learning, surveys, and graduation pathways, helping K-12 districts use data and AI to understand student needs and take effective action. Panorama enables better decisions and improved outcomes for more than 15 million students nationwide across instruction, student support, special education, and graduation pathways.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based student support and MTSS platform that combines academic, attendance, behavior, and student voice data to identify needs, manage interventions, track progress, and support referrals.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama Student Success

productsAndServices.description: A district-managed AI platform that uses approved district materials and student data to generate context-specific insights, intervention plans, instructional resources, family communications, and other educator workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama Solara

productsAndServices.description: A school survey and feedback platform for collecting and analyzing student, family, teacher, and staff perspectives on school climate, safety, engagement, belonging, absenteeism, and other educational topics.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama Surveys and Engagement

productsAndServices.description: A graduation and readiness tracking platform that audits transcripts and schedules, monitors credits and course progressions, identifies errors, and tracks graduation, CTE, distinction, and post-secondary readiness plans.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama Pathways

productsAndServices.description: An AI learning tool for teachers and students that supports differentiated assignments, assignment and rubric creation, and instant rubric-aligned feedback with opportunities for revision.
productsAndServices.name: Class Companion

productsAndServices.description: A professional learning and intervention resource library containing more than 1,000 research- and evidence-based strategies for academics, behavior, school climate, and other MTSS needs.
productsAndServices.name: Panorama Playbook

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $60,000,000, or 64.75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,838,420 to $428,869,342, a 233.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 66 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Ellucian, Alpaca, Stellic.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
